Subject: SF Conf — Exec dinner & on-site demo (FastScale)

Hi Sally / Jason —

Great meeting last week at the track session. As discussed, we want to do a short on-site demo the week after SF Conf and an exec dinner for your leadership and ours. Proposed plan:

- Wed 14 Jul: 2pm on-site product demo at FastScale HQ (engineering + security + procurement welcome)
- Wed 14 Jul: 7pm exec dinner (private table)

Dylan (SE) — can you confirm the demo agenda below and what we need for the environment (VPN, sample data, SOC artifacts)?
Neha (Security) — do you want to join the demo or a pre-call?

Attaching an agenda draft and adding a tentative calendar invite. If these times conflict with SF Conf flights, happy to shift Thurs 15th as backup.

Agenda (attached): 45 min demo (scoping & performance), 15 min Q&A, 30 min procurement/next-steps

Thanks —

marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: SF Conf — Exec dinner & on-site demo (FastScale)

Marissa —

Thanks for the note. Wed 14 Jul is looking tight for our engineering leads because several of us are returning from the conference on late flights. We do want the onsite demo and dinner; can we either:

A) Move the demo to Thu 15 Jul at 10am and keep the dinner Wed 7pm (some of leadership will be in town earlier), OR
B) Keep the demo Wed 14 but start at 11am with a shorter window (30 min), and push the dinner to Thu 7pm.

Jason (eng) — any preference? Procurement (cc) — will you need a PoC agreement or a procurement pre-read before execs are present?

Best,
Sally
Head of Product | FastScale
+sally.chen@fastscale.com

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SF Conf — Exec dinner & on-site demo (FastScale)

Sally —

Either option works from an SE perspective. If you take option A (Thu 10am), I can run the full 45-minute demo and include latency/cost slides tailored to your query patterns. For option B (Wed 11am condensed), I can do a focused 30-minute deep-dive on throughput and routing, then follow up with a recorded walkthrough for your infra team.

For the onsite setup I need:
- One laptop HDMI + local WiFi (VPN access preferred)
- Sample dataset (anonymized) or access to a staging API key
- Point of contact from engineering for any firewall/VPC questions

I can bring our test scripts and the perf dashboard.

—Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood

Sally / Marissa —

I can join either day for the demo. Quick ask from security: please send over your standard SOC 2 and network architecture questions in advance (or point me to a procurement security questionnaire). If you prefer we can do a 20-minute pre-call Mon 13 Jul at 10am PT to go through punch-list items.

Vivek, looping you for any additional compliance docs (encryption/KMS).
